verdict.rationale: x402 is now governed by the vendor-neutral x402 Foundation under the Linux Foundation, which publishes the SDK and has 40 member organizations. Several independent parties actually implement the protocol: httpay.xyz runs 124 x402 endpoints, Apiosk built an x402-enforcing gateway, Cloudflare has proposed its own payment schemes, and AWS integrates it via AgentCore. Missing for 10: evidence of independent facilitator implementations beyond Coinbase's hosted CDP Facilitator, and confirmation of which Foundation members ship production implementations rather than just holding governance seats.
